Cast with Roles

  • Robert De Niro as Detective Peter Willis (Retired lead detective who captured Frank Carter)
  • Adam Scott as Tom Kennedy (Recently widowed novelist fighting to save Jake)
  • Michelle Monaghan as Detective Amanda Beck (Tenacious lead detective)
  • Acston Luca Porto as Jake Kennedy (Tom's young son)
  • John Carroll Lynch as Frank Carter (The Whisper Man)
  • Owen Teague as Francis Carter Jr. (Copycat killer)
  • Hamish Linklater as Norman Collins

    • Director(s): James Ashcroft | Screenplay: Ben Jacoby, Chase Palmer | Novel: Alex North

    Summary: Widowed novelist Tom Kennedy and his young son Jake move to Garretton following a child abduction connected to serial killer Frank Carter, aka the Whisper Man. When Jake is abducted, Tom teams with his estranged detective father to solve the nightmare. Source:Wikipedia

    Plot

    In 2026, Garretton Detective Amanda Beck discovers the body of a boy while searching for another missing child, Neil Spencer. The crime emulates notorious serial killer Frank Carter, dubbed the Whisper Man, who murdered boys in the 1990s before being captured by Detective Peter Willis. Frank whispered to his victims and left chilling recordings to torment grieving parents. Recently widowed novelist Tom Kennedy moves to Garretton with his traumatized young son Jake. After Jake is lured and abducted by a copycat following the Whisper Man rhyme, Tom turns to his estranged father, Detective Peter Willis. Together with Detective Beck, they unravel a sinister plot involving Frank's dark disciples, hidden basement remains, and long-buried family secrets. Source:IMDB
